_about: Study page (study.html), rendered by js/study.js. This file lists the exams; each exam's questions are in its own file ("file"), shown ten at a time. An exam is multiple choice by default: each question has exactly 4 options, answer (the 0-based index of the right one) and why (one or two plain sentences). An exam with "format": "tasks" has hands-on tasks instead: task (what to do), steps (commands or lines, in order) and check (how to confirm it worked). The question files are written by rag/make_questions.mjs from the library's study guides and practice-test books (see README, Study). tests/study.test.mjs checks the shape.
note: Questions show ten at a time; use Shuffle for a new order. The RHCSA panel has hands-on tasks: do each one on your own practice VM, then compare.

exams.name: Security+
exams.about: CompTIA's entry-level security certification: threats, architecture, operations and governance.

exams.name: Network+
exams.about: CompTIA's networking certification: addressing, routing and switching, wireless, troubleshooting and network security.

exams.name: CySA+
exams.about: CompTIA's security analyst certification: detection, vulnerability management and incident response.

exams.name: PenTest+
exams.about: CompTIA's penetration testing certification: planning and scoping, reconnaissance, attacks and reporting.

exams.name: Linux
exams.about: General Linux administration on any distribution: the ground CompTIA Linux+ and the Linux Foundation's LFCS cover.

exams.name: RHCSA
exams.about: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (EX200), on RHEL 10. The exam is hands-on: you configure a live system, so these are tasks, not multiple choice.
